video.title: AI欧腐《警官，别闯我的梦/Don't Enter My Dream Officer》
video.desc:
Rookie dream-cop Elias has hunted the elusive "Nightmare" for a year and always lost — mocked, pinned, and toyed with, yet never once harmed; the dream gem is always taken and always returned. Ordered by Chief Marcus to uncover why the Nightmare keeps breaking into dreams, Elias is suddenly shadowed by the new "dream-safety expert," Lucien Cross, who forces him into a three-part compatibility program — knowing each other's bodies, obedience testing, and resonance testing — and moves him into his mansion. A fall into a dream-within-a-dream shows Elias a Christmas Eve fourteen years ago: in a collapsing amusement park, a 12-year-old Lucien met him, and has searched for him ever since. When Lucien's identity is exposed, he flees to clear his mother Helena's name. Elias awakens his buried memories through a single bell mark — and discovers the true mastermind is Chief Marcus, who stole Helena's "dream lock," faked her death, and framed Lucien. Together they trigger the dream lock's ultimate resonance, expose the truth, and end Marcus — closing a fourteen-year obsession.

菜鸟梦境警察 Elias 追捕神出鬼没的"梦魇"整整一年,却屡战屡败:被嘲弄,被压制,被玩弄于股掌之间,却从未受过一丝伤害;梦境宝石每次都被夺走,又每次都被原样归还。
局长 Marcus 命他查明"梦魇"屡屡闯入梦境的真正原因。与此同时,新来的"梦境安全专家"Lucien Cross 突然对他如影随形,逼他参加一套三阶段的契合度计划——了解彼此的身体、服从测试、共鸣测试,还让他搬进了自己的庄园。
一次意外,Elias 坠入梦中之梦,看见了十四年前的平安夜:在一座正在崩塌的游乐园里,十二岁的 Lucien 遇见了他,从此寻找至今。
身份暴露后,Lucien 出逃,只为替母亲 Helena 洗清罪名。Elias 凭着一枚铃铛印记唤醒了尘封的记忆,并发现真正的幕后黑手竟是局长 Marcus:他盗走了 Helena 的"梦锁",伪造了她的死亡,又嫁祸给 Lucien。
两人携手触发梦锁的终极共鸣,揭开真相,终结了 Marcus,也为这场长达十四年的执念画上句号。
